name: LIELLA_NATIVE_VERSION
doc: The newest version node this header describes: LIELLA_NATIVE_<n>.

name: LIELLA_HEAP_MIN_ALIGN
doc: The alignment every heap block has at least.

name: LIELLA_O_RDONLY
doc: Open for reading only.

name: LIELLA_O_WRONLY
doc: Open for writing only.

name: LIELLA_O_RDWR
doc: Open for reading and writing.

name: LIELLA_O_CREAT
doc: Create the file if it does not exist (with the mode given).

name: LIELLA_O_EXCL
doc: With LIELLA_O_CREAT: fail with -EEXIST if the file exists.

name: LIELLA_O_TRUNC
doc: Truncate a regular file opened for writing to length 0.

name: LIELLA_O_APPEND
doc: Every write appends at the end of the file.

name: LIELLA_O_NONBLOCK
doc: Non-blocking I/O.

name: LIELLA_O_DIRECTORY
doc: Fail with -ENOTDIR unless the path names a directory.

name: LIELLA_O_NOFOLLOW
doc: Fail with -ELOOP if the final component is a symbolic link.

name: LIELLA_O_CLOEXEC
doc: Close the descriptor on exec.

name: LIELLA_SEEK_SET
doc: The offset is absolute.

name: LIELLA_SEEK_CUR
doc: The offset is relative to the current offset.

name: LIELLA_SEEK_END
doc: The offset is relative to the end of the file.

name: LIELLA_FS_NOFOLLOW
doc: liella_fs_stat: describe a final symbolic link itself.

name: LIELLA_S_IFMT
doc: The file-type bits of liella_stat.mode.

name: LIELLA_S_IFSOCK
doc: A socket.

name: LIELLA_S_IFLNK
doc: A symbolic link.

name: LIELLA_S_IFREG
doc: A regular file.

name: LIELLA_S_IFBLK
doc: A block device.

name: LIELLA_S_IFDIR
doc: A directory.

name: LIELLA_S_IFCHR
doc: A character device.

name: LIELLA_S_IFIFO
doc: A FIFO.

name: LIELLA_LC_CTYPE
doc: The locale category LC_CTYPE.

name: LIELLA_LC_NUMERIC
doc: The locale category LC_NUMERIC.

name: LIELLA_LC_TIME
doc: The locale category LC_TIME.

name: LIELLA_LC_COLLATE
doc: The locale category LC_COLLATE.

name: LIELLA_LC_MONETARY
doc: The locale category LC_MONETARY.

name: LIELLA_LC_MESSAGES
doc: The locale category LC_MESSAGES.

name: LIELLA_LC_ALL
doc: All categories (liella_locale_name: the composite name).

name: LIELLA_LC_PAPER
doc: The locale category LC_PAPER.

name: LIELLA_LC_NAME
doc: The locale category LC_NAME.

name: LIELLA_LC_ADDRESS
doc: The locale category LC_ADDRESS.

name: LIELLA_LC_TELEPHONE
doc: The locale category LC_TELEPHONE.

name: LIELLA_LC_MEASUREMENT
doc: The locale category LC_MEASUREMENT.

name: LIELLA_LC_IDENTIFICATION
doc: The locale category LC_IDENTIFICATION.

name: LIELLA_TZ_ABBR_CAP
doc: The capacity of liella_tm.abbr.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_HOSTS
doc: Name-service cache category: hosts (gethostbyname*, gethostbyaddr, getaddrinfo, getnameinfo).

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_PASSWD
doc: Name-service cache category: the passwd database by name and UID.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_GROUP
doc: Name-service cache category: the group database by name and GID, and group lists.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_SERVICES
doc: Name-service cache category: services by name and port.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_PROTOCOLS
doc: Name-service cache category: protocols by name and number.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_NETWORKS
doc: Name-service cache category: networks by name and number.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_ALL
doc: liella_nscache_invalidate: every category.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_MODE_OFF
doc: liella_nscache_info.mode: the cache is disabled (nothing mapped, no stat, no table).

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_MODE_IDLE
doc: liella_nscache_info.mode: enabled, no table yet (no lookup since start, enable or a credential change).

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_MODE_PRIVATE
doc: liella_nscache_info.mode: a table of this process only.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_MODE_SHARED
doc: liella_nscache_info.mode: the shared region of the effective user (/dev/shm/liella-nscache-<euid>).

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_MODE_UNAVAILABLE
doc: liella_nscache_info.mode: enabled, but no table could be made; lookups are not cached.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_REASON_NONE
doc: liella_nscache_info.reason: the shared region is used.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_REASON_NO_REGION
doc: liella_nscache_info.reason: the process has no region location (not started by the library).

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_REASON_SECURE
doc: liella_nscache_info.reason: AT_SECURE, or real and effective user or group IDs differ.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_REASON_REFUSED
doc: liella_nscache_info.reason: the region file is not trusted (owner, mode, type, size, symbolic link); it is left untouched.

name: LIELLA_NSCACHE_REASON_UNAVAILABLE
doc: liella_nscache_info.reason: the region could not be opened, created, sized, locked or mapped.

name: LIELLA_GETPASS_DEFAULT_LIMIT
doc: getpass's default bound: the most bytes of input before the newline (1 MiB).

name: liella_timespec
doc: An instant (seconds and nanoseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) or a clock reading.

name: liella_timespec.sec
doc: Seconds.

name: liella_timespec.nsec
doc: Nanoseconds, 0 to 999999999.

name: liella_stat
doc: A file's status.

name: liella_stat.dev
doc: The device holding the file.

name: liella_stat.ino
doc: The inode number.

name: liella_stat.nlink
doc: The number of hard links.

name: liella_stat.rdev
doc: The device a special file stands for.

name: liella_stat.size
doc: The size in bytes.

name: liella_stat.blksize
doc: The preferred I/O block size.

name: liella_stat.blocks
doc: The 512-byte blocks allocated.

name: liella_stat.atime
doc: The last access.

name: liella_stat.mtime
doc: The last modification of the contents.

name: liella_stat.ctime
doc: The last change of the status.

name: liella_stat.mode
doc: The type (LIELLA_S_IF*) and permission bits.

name: liella_stat.uid
doc: The owner.

name: liella_stat.gid
doc: The group.

name: liella_stat.reserved
doc: Always 0.

name: liella_tm
doc: A local time in the current zone. As input (liella_tz_from_local) year to second and isdst are read; out-of-range values carry.

name: liella_tm.year
doc: The full year (2026 is 2026).

name: liella_tm.second
doc: 0 to 60 (60 only for an inserted leap second).

name: liella_tm.weekday
doc: 0 to 6, Sunday = 0.

name: liella_tm.yearday
doc: 0 to 365: days since 1 January.

name: liella_tm.isdst
doc: 1 daylight time, 0 not; as input, negative lets the zone decide.

name: liella_tm.utc_offset
doc: Seconds east of UTC.

name: liella_tm.abbr_len
doc: The abbreviation's full length; abbr holds it only if it is at most LIELLA_TZ_ABBR_CAP.

name: liella_tm.abbr
doc: The zone abbreviation, not NUL-terminated.

name: liella_nscache_info
doc: The state of the process's name-service cache (liella_nscache_status).

name: liella_nscache_info.enabled
doc: 1 enabled, 0 disabled.

name: liella_nscache_info.categories
doc: The enabled categories: bit 1 << LIELLA_NSCACHE_<category>.

name: liella_nscache_info.mode
doc: LIELLA_NSCACHE_MODE_*.

name: liella_nscache_info.reason
doc: Why the table is not the shared region: LIELLA_NSCACHE_REASON_*.

name: liella_nscache_info.owner
doc: The shared region's user ID; UINT64_MAX without one.

name: liella_nscache_info.generation
doc: The sum of the table's generations: it moves with every invalidation; 0 without a table.

name: liella_nscache_info.hits
doc: Lookups this process answered from the table.

name: liella_nscache_info.misses
doc: Cached lookups this process had to ask the sources for.

name: liella_nscache_info.stats
doc: stat calls this process made to validate the watched files.

name: liella_nscache_info.stores
doc: Answers this process stored in the table.

name: liella_heap_alloc
doc: size bytes aligned to align (any power of two; every block is aligned to at least LIELLA_HEAP_MIN_ALIGN), or NULL. Size 0 gives a unique block.

name: liella_heap_alloc_zeroed
doc: As liella_heap_alloc, with the size bytes zeroed.

name: liella_heap_alloc_secure
doc: A secure block: as liella_heap_alloc, reading as zero, in a mapping of its own kept out of core dumps. Whatever releases it (liella_heap_free, free, or liella_heap_realloc and realloc moving it) zeroes it before its memory can be reused; a reallocated block stays secure.

name: liella_heap_realloc
doc: The block resized, contents kept up to the smaller size, or NULL (the block unchanged). NULL ptr allocates; size 0 frees and gives NULL. Aligned to LIELLA_HEAP_MIN_ALIGN only. A secure block stays secure, and the bytes past its old usable size read as zero; moved, the old block is zeroed.

name: liella_heap_free
doc: Release the block at ptr (NULL: nothing).

name: liella_heap_usable_size
doc: The bytes usable in the block at ptr (at least its size; 0 for NULL).

name: liella_secure_zero
doc: Zero the len bytes at ptr so that the stores are never optimised away, even inlined or under LTO and if the bytes are never read again (explicit_bzero calls it). NULL with len 0 does nothing.

name: liella_env_get
detail: const uint8_t *name, size_t name_len, uint8_t *buf, size_t buf_len
doc: The value of the variable name into buf: its length, or -ENOENT.

name: liella_env_set
detail: const uint8_t *name, size_t name_len, const uint8_t *value, size_t value_len, uint32_t overwrite
doc: Set the variable name to a copy of value; an existing one is replaced only if overwrite is non-zero.

name: liella_env_unset
doc: Remove every entry of the variable name.

name: liella_env_count
doc: The number of entries in the environment.

name: liella_env_entry
doc: Entry index (NAME=VALUE) into buf: its length, or -ENOENT past the last.

name: liella_environ_contract
doc: The environment contract, a Liella extension (off by default; docs/interfaces.md): non-zero on turns it on, 0 off; the previous state (1 on, 0 off). While it is on, getenv answers from a table of the names that setenv, putenv, unsetenv and clearenv keep current; a change made to environ, an entry of it or a putenv string's name without them is seen only after liella_environ_reload.

name: liella_environ_reload
doc: Rebuild the environment contract's table from environ, after a change made without setenv, putenv, unsetenv or clearenv (nothing while the contract is off).

name: liella_fd_read
doc: Read up to len bytes: the count (0 at end of file).

name: liella_fd_write
detail: int32_t fd, const uint8_t *buf, size_t len
doc: Write up to len bytes: the count.

name: liella_fd_pread
detail: int32_t fd, uint8_t *buf, size_t len, int64_t offset
doc: Read up to len bytes at offset: the count.

name: liella_fd_pwrite
detail: int32_t fd, const uint8_t *buf, size_t len, int64_t offset
doc: Write up to len bytes at offset: the count.

name: liella_fd_close
doc: Close fd (released even when the result is an error).

name: liella_fd_seek
detail: int32_t fd, int64_t offset, uint32_t whence
doc: Move the offset (LIELLA_SEEK_*): the new offset.

name: liella_fd_stat
doc: The status of the file open as fd into *out.

name: liella_fs_open
detail: const uint8_t *path, size_t path_len, uint32_t flags, uint32_t mode
doc: Open the file at path (LIELLA_O_*; CLOEXEC is not implied): the descriptor.

name: liella_fs_stat
detail: const uint8_t *path, size_t path_len, uint32_t flags, struct liella_stat *out
doc: The status of the file at path into *out (flags 0 or LIELLA_FS_NOFOLLOW).

name: liella_fs_mkdir
detail: const uint8_t *path, size_t path_len, uint32_t mode
doc: Create the directory path.

name: liella_fs_unlink
doc: Remove the directory entry path (not a directory).

name: liella_fs_rmdir
doc: Remove the empty directory path.

name: liella_fs_rename
detail: const uint8_t *from, size_t from_len, const uint8_t *to, size_t to_len
doc: Rename from to to, replacing to if it exists.

name: liella_clock_realtime
doc: The current time into *out.

name: liella_clock_monotonic
doc: The monotonic clock into *out.

name: liella_tz_to_local
doc: The local time of the instant time into *out, with offset and abbreviation.

name: liella_tz_from_local
doc: The instant of the local time *tm into *time; *tm normalised. Both left alone on failure.

name: liella_tz_invalidate
doc: Reload the time-zone data: every zone kept from a file is compared with its file before its next use and read again if the file changed (a tzdata update); then the zone TZ names is selected, as tzset does. Zones are otherwise kept for the life of the process. 0.

name: liella_locale_name
doc: The current locale's name of category (LIELLA_LC_*; LIELLA_LC_ALL: composite) into buf: its length.

name: liella_locale_decimal_point
doc: The current locale's decimal point into buf: its length.

name: liella_locale_invalidate
doc: Reload the locale data: every mapped locale file and charmap is compared with its file before its next use and read again if the file changed; then the global locale is loaded again by its names. Locale objects (newlocale, duplocale) keep their data. 0, or -ENOENT when a name of the global locale no longer resolves (it is then unchanged).

name: liella_process_exit
doc: End the process as exit(status): C exit handlers, stream flush, exit.

name: liella_process_arg_count
doc: The number of program arguments (argc).

name: liella_process_arg
doc: Argument index into buf: its length, or -ENOENT past the count.

name: liella_process_id
doc: The process ID.

name: liella_nscache_enable
doc: Enable (on non-zero) or disable the process's name-service cache: 1 if it was enabled, else 0. Disabled, a lookup costs one atomic load and nothing is mapped, stat'ed or kept; the table is dropped.

name: liella_nscache_category
doc: Enable or disable one category (LIELLA_NSCACHE_HOSTS ... NETWORKS) for this process: 1 if it was enabled, else 0; -EINVAL for another number.

name: liella_nscache_invalidate
doc: Invalidate one category, or every one (LIELLA_NSCACHE_ALL), in this process's table and the user's shared region (every process of the user drops those answers); the next lookup validates the watched files at once. 0, or -EINVAL.

name: liella_nscache_status
doc: The cache's state into *out.

name: liella_aio_use_threads
doc: Run this process's POSIX AIO requests on worker threads, never on io_uring: 0, or -EBUSY once a request has started io_uring (call it before the first request). It holds for the life of the process and in its fork children. The workers are also chosen without this call in secure-execution mode, under a seccomp filter, or with LIELLA_AIO_URING=0 in the environment at the first request.

name: liella_getpass_set_limit
doc: Set the process's bound on getpass's line to bytes (0: LIELLA_GETPASS_DEFAULT_LIMIT again): the bound that was in force, or -EINVAL above PTRDIFF_MAX. A longer line is read to its end and discarded, every library buffer that held it zeroed, and getpass fails with EOVERFLOW (never a truncated password). It holds for the life of the process and in its fork children.
